summary: Comprehensive test suite with strong coverage of all major requirements. LicenseChecker.Tests.ps1 provides thorough unit tests for manifest parsing (package.json, requirements.txt), license classification (approved/denied/unknown), report generation, and CLI behavior across all three exit codes. Workflow.Tests.ps1 validates workflow structure, triggers, permissions, and actionlint compliance. Run-ActTests.ps1 offers valuable integration testing through act with three realistic fixture scenarios (mixed compliance, all-approved, unknowns) and assertion on exact output strings. Well-organized using Pester conventions with proper BeforeAll setup, fixture management via TestDrive, correct mock usage, and test independence. Rigor is strong—edge cases include invalid JSON, missing files, null licenses, case-insensitive matching, unsupported manifest types, and -FailOnViolation behavior. Minor gaps: could test additional config validation scenarios, and Run-ActTests.ps1 lacks helper functions to reduce repetition. Tests assume correct implementation of referenced src/LicenseChecker.psm1 module (not provided in implementation block). Overall, this suite would reliably catch regressions and provides good confidence in functionality.
